title: LoopEvent
description: The full wire vocabulary of a loopengine turn — mirrors core/loop-events.ts exactly. One object per event; `type` is both the JSON discriminant and, on the SSE transport, the literal `event:` field name. See /PROTOCOL.md for transport bindings and stability guarantees.

scope.description: ActAuth's own Scope — which rules apply.

budgetCheck.description: Engine. Read-only context-budget check, run once per model call.

promptCompaction.description: Engine. The prompt was rejected as too long, so compaction.ts's own recovery kicked in. from/to are message-array lengths, not token counts. The only recovery type with a dedicated event today — recovery.ts's other two failure modes (media-too-large, truncated output) have no hook wired up in run-agent.ts yet, so neither can currently fire.

assistantText.description: Engine. The model's own preamble alongside a tool_use request — the only live glimpse of assistant text before the turn's final answer.

actauthDecision.description: Engine. One ActAuth Gate.evaluate() outcome per requested tool call. decision:'allow' can still mean a human was asked and said yes — see approval:pending for the live ask itself.

toolStarted.description: Engine. Fired the instant a call is decided, before it runs. Matched to its later tool:result by id.

toolResult.description: Engine. A tool call's resolution — auto-allowed, interactively approved, denied, or skipped alike. args/detailText are omitted on some denied/skipped paths.

toollaneResult.description: Engine. ToolLane's own raw fulfil/reject outcome, logged alongside (not instead of) tool:result.

skillLoad.description: Engine. A Skill tool_use block was resolved to a real skill body via SkillGarden's own lazy load. Not gated by ActAuth — Skill invocation isn't a real tool call.

loopSkipped.description: Engine. An approved call never ran because a sibling call in the same batch was denied — the whole batch cancels together.

loopMaxTurns.description: Engine. Hit config.maxTurns without the model producing a final answer. Terminal for the turn — see 'done'.

loopDenied.description: Engine. A human denied at least one requested tool call this turn — the whole turn stops right there. Terminal for the turn — see 'done'.

loopDone.description: Engine. A genuine finish — the model produced text with no more tool_use blocks. Terminal for the turn — see 'done'.

session.description: Adapter. First event of every streamed turn — echoes back which session id this turn used.

approvalPending.description: Adapter. A tool call needs a live human 'ask' decision. Resolve via POST /approvals/:id/approve or /deny.

questionPending.description: Adapter. The system ask_user tool raised a genuinely ambiguous question. Resolve via POST /questions/:id/answer.

done.description: Adapter. The turn is over — covers loop:done, loop:max_turns, and loop:denied alike. The one event every consumer can treat as 'nothing more is coming'.

error.description: Adapter. Something failed after the response was already committed — surfaced in-band since it's too late for an HTTP status code.
